headline: As of 2026-10-03: 1,182,549 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 30 of 50 states, D+33.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 1,182,549 early/mail ballots cast so far across 30 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+33.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Virginia (348,693), New Jersey (154,812), Florida (142,995).
